subject: chemistry
title: Complex Constellation: Ligands and Shapes
welcome_lead: Build complex ions from ligands and predict their geometry.
meta_desc: A-Level chemistry adventure on complex ions, ligands and coordination shapes.
final_note: You assembled the geometry of coordination chemistry.

concepts.def: Number of dative bonds to metal.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Monodentate: H2O, NH3, Cl-, CN- (one lone pair donated).

Bidentate: ethanedioate (C2O4^2-), 1,2-diaminoethane (en). Hexadentate: EDTA^4- (6 donor atoms).

Coord no. 6 -> octahedral (e.g. [Fe(H2O)6]^3+). Coord no. 4 with Cl- ligands often tetrahedral due to size.

d8 ions like [Ni(CN)4]^2- or Pt^2+ adopt square planar geometry due to orbital splitting.

[Cu(H2O)6]^2+ (pale blue) + excess NH3 -> [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]^2+ (deep blue). Both 6-coordinate.

[Cu(H2O)6]^2+ + 4Cl- -> [CuCl4]^2- (yellow, tetrahedral). Coordination number and shape change.

mcqs.q: Common shape of complex with 4 Cl- ligands?
If a complex ion has a coordination number of 4, what shape does it have?
options: A coordination number of 4 always means square planar because complexes prefer to be flat.
A coordination number of 4 always means tetrahedral, because that gives the maximum bond-angle separation.
The ligand shares electrons equally with the metal as a normal covalent bond.
It can be either tetrahedral OR square planar — the shape depends on the metal and ligands (e.g. [Pt(NH3)4]2+ is square planar; [CuCl4]2- is tetrahedral).

mcqs.q: What kind of bond forms between a ligand and a central metal ion in a complex?
options: The colour changes because the new ligand is itself coloured.
A dative (coordinate) covalent bond — the ligand donates a lone pair into an empty orbital on the metal.
The ligand shares electrons equally with the metal as a normal covalent bond.
The ligand forms an ionic bond with the metal because the metal is positively charged.

mcqs.q: Why does the colour of a transition metal complex change when ligands are exchanged?
options: A coordination number of 4 always means square planar because complexes prefer to be flat.
The colour changes because the new ligand is itself coloured.
Different ligands cause different amounts of d-orbital splitting, so different wavelengths of light are absorbed.
The colour changes because the metal ion itself changes oxidation state.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Ligand”?
options: Number of dative bonds to metal.
